description: Quarter-turn degree fan: retain the nineteen confirmed five-degree labels and long-line order, two joined perpendicular boundaries, and truncated internal long lines. Exact angular spacing and 72 one-degree short marks are explicitly text-driven modern regularization of the stated ninety equal parts, NOT a pixel certification of the ambiguous source marks. HOLD-215-TICKS remains in the source evidence. The three tiny unlabeled boundary dots are modern anchor markers.

authoritativeText.text:
我们把一直角分成90等份，就得到90个合同的角（图215）。
每一个小角等于直角的$\frac{1}{90}$。
一个直角的九十分之一叫做一度，并把它作为度量角的单位。

如果角$MOP$包含40度，那么就说角$MOP$的大小等于40度，写作：
$\widehat{MOP}=40^{\circ}$。

“$^{\circ}$”是角的度量单位——度的符号。
应当分清楚$\angle MOP$和$\widehat{MOP}$这两种写法。
第一种写法读作“角$MOP$”，而第二种写法读作“角$MOP$的大小”。

直角的大小等于$90^{\circ}$，而平角的大小等于$180^{\circ}$。
任何锐角都小于$90^{\circ}$，而任何钝角都大于$90^{\circ}$小于$180^{\circ}$。
如果角$ABC$是锐角，而角$KED$是钝角，那么下列不等式就是真的：
$\widehat{ABC}<90^{\circ}$，
$90^{\circ}<\widehat{KED}<180^{\circ}$。

inventory.description: Source pixels confirm the boundary corner, 0/5/.../90 degree labels, nineteen major directions, truncated internal major lines and a fine-mark band. Exact angular spacing, inner radii and three tiny boundary dots are declared modern regularization; source slopes and lengths are not claimed as measured. Unknown individual minor-mark count and endpoint pixels remain HOLD-215-TICKS.

Explicit modern additions, NOT pixel-confirmed source objects: the ninety equal degree intervals stated in the prose require direction positions 0 through 90. Nineteen are five-degree major positions; the other 72 are short marks at the non-multiples of five. Exact radial displacements bind their k-degree positions and truncated endpoints; no unknown pixel count is used. The total 91-position assertion includes both groups.
